schema_note: OPERATION XXV-2 (#166), hardened by the XXV red-team (finding 3). Independent-measurement holdouts for the measured_validation lane of science/status_record.py. Each entry: {"id": str, "description": str, "prereg_commit": the FULL 40-hex lowercase SHA of the commit that preregistered the comparison BEFORE it was run (abbreviations, refs such as HEAD/main, and the run commit itself are refused), "qualified": JSON bool (true only for an independent measurement with a stated uncertainty, preregistered with a fail-capable criterion), "outcome": "PASS" | "FAIL" | "PENDING", "evidence": repo-relative path of the committed result, "evidence_sha256": 64-hex lowercase sha256 of that file's bytes, "tier": optional str; "W" = weak, nuisance-limited (e.g. an unmeasured nuisance such as pCO2, or an unstated replicate count): tier W can never qualify, so a qualified entry of tier W makes the lane INVALID_REGISTRY (it may be recorded with qualified false)}. A qualified entry is VERIFIED only if, with git: prereg_commit resolves to a commit that is a STRICT ancestor of the run commit and of every commit that added the evidence path; this registry AT prereg_commit already holds the same id as a qualified PENDING entry; and the evidence file exists at the run commit with exactly evidence_sha256. ANY malformed or unverifiable entry (including a non-boolean 'qualified') makes the lane INVALID_REGISTRY (fail closed, never silently dropped); any verified qualified FAIL makes it FAIL regardless of other PASS entries; PASS needs a verified qualified PASS; anything else is UNVERIFIED. No entry exists today: OPERATION XXIV section 6 found no qualified independent holdout (2.0-alpha gate NOT MET).
